main_text.head: CAPUT VI.

head.i: Ex scopo ac fine unico Concilij, quæ fuit restitutio Photij a depositis, & excommunicatis profecta, antequam accessisset assensus Pontificis Romani, hoc idem ostenditur,

main_text.p: Quæ porro de causa Synodus ista cogitur? Non alia prorsus, nisi ut Photius, vel saltem illius restitutio Synodali decreto comprobetur. Sed ante coactam Synodum Photius iam thronum occupauerat, & Imperatoris violentissima tempestate, ac Ioannis Pontificis indulgentia, ut paucis aliquid dicam, novum in modum invaserat. Temere ergo Synodus celebratur, neque enim in possessionem auctoritate Romani Pontificis, & Imperatoris restitutus, calculo Synodali ad gradum, unde ceciderat, reponendus videbatur. page.notes: The Greek passage is printed skewed at the foot of the text block. Several Greek words are doubtful: the opening words "Οἱ ἐξ ἡμῶν" and "Θεὸν μέγιστον ἀρχιερέως" and the word "ἡνωμένον" are my best reading, not certain. The Greek ends with "ἔχον-" at the line end, which continues on the next page. The opening Q of "Quæ" is a large initial and is joined to its word. Spelling of u/v and i/j has been modernised as instructed; all other spelling is as printed, including "ampullatis" and "sesquipedalibus".
